title: feat(i18n): add missing translations for plugin-detail, plugin-view, plugin-map, plugin-workflow
body:
Comprehensive i18n audit across all packages. Added missing translation keys and wired up components in `plugin-detail`.

### Locale files (all 10 languages: en, zh, ja, ko, de, fr, es, pt, ru, ar)

- **New `view` namespace** (14 keys) — ViewTabBar: rename, duplicate, share, pin, delete, save-as-view
- **New `map` namespace** (5 keys) — ObjectMap: search, location details, coordinate warnings
- **New `workflow` namespace** (59 keys) — WorkflowDesigner/FlowDesigner: node types, statuses, properties, concurrency policies, BPMN tools
- **Extended `detail` namespace** (55+ keys) — comments, attachments, diff viewer, discussion panel, rich text toolbar, subscription toggle, record navigation, activity timeline, threaded replies

### Component updates (`plugin-detail`)

All 9 sub-components now use `useDetailTranslation()` instead of hardcoded English strings:

- `RecordComments`, `CommentAttachment`, `DiffView`, `RecordChatterPanel`
- `RichTextCommentInput`, `SubscriptionToggle`, `RecordNavigationEnhanced`
- `RecordActivityTimeline`, `ThreadedReplies`

```tsx
// Before
<CardTitle>Comments</CardTitle>
<input placeholder="Search comments…" />

// After
const { t } = useDetailTranslation();
<CardTitle>{t('detail.comments')}</CardTitle>
<input placeholder={t('detail.searchComments')} />
```

### Not yet completed

Translation keys are defined in all locale files but components not yet wired up for:
- `plugin-view/ViewTabBar.tsx`
- `plugin-map/ObjectMap.tsx`
- `plugin-workflow/WorkflowDesigner.tsx`, `FlowDesigner.tsx`

These need safe translation hooks created (following the `createSafeTranslationHook` pattern from `plugin-detail`) and string replacements in the components.
